statements.subject: session
statements.description: Phase 1 is responsible for calculating the degree of preference for each route received from a peer.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Phase 2 is invoked on completion of phase 1. It is responsible for choosing the best route out of all those available for each distinct destination, and for installing each chosen route into the Loc-RIB.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Phase 3 is invoked after the Loc-RIB has been modified. It is responsible for disseminating routes in the Loc-RIB to each peer, according to the policies contained in the PIB. Route aggregation and information reduction can optionally be performed within this phase.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Phase 1 is triggered by a route being received from a peer; it calculates the degree of preference for that route.
actions: apply degree-of-preference function to received route
mark route eligible or ineligible for Loc-RIB installation

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Phase 2 is invoked on completion of phase 1; it selects the best route for each distinct destination and installs it into the Loc-RIB.
actions: choose best route for each distinct destination

statements.subject: session
statements.description: Phase 3 is invoked after the Loc-RIB has been modified; it disseminates routes in the Loc-RIB to each peer according to PIB policies, with optional route aggregation.
actions: disseminate Loc-RIB routes to each peer per PIB policy
optionally perform route aggregation and information reduction
